description: Generate a ready-to-run Apache JMeter 5.6.3 .jmx practice test plan (either "solved" with Boundary/JSON/Header extractors or "challenge" with broken hardcoded tokens) targeting the live docs.jmeter.ai/api/sandbox endpoints or local localhost:8787 server.

flowId.description: Practice flow: "flow1" (CSRF + Cookie), "flow2" (JWT Bearer + Order chain), "flow3" (ASP.NET __VIEWSTATE + Header ticket), or "flow4" (HTTP 429 & JSON Assertion chaos). Default: "flow1".

mode.description: "solved" returns a working correlated .jmx plan; "challenge" returns a broken plan with hardcoded recorded tokens for debugging practice. Default: "solved".

target.description: "edge" targets https://docs.jmeter.ai/api/sandbox (1-thread debug); "local" targets http://localhost:8787/api/sandbox (high-RPS). Default: "edge".

name: get_correlation_sandbox
title: Get Correlation & Practice Sandbox Test Plan
